correctness.rationale: With K(z,w)=-1/[pi(z-conj(w))^2], factorial derivatives in the canonical Riesz family and real coefficient vector (1,a,b) cancel odd powers and give F(t)=1+6(b-a^2)t^2+30b^2t^4. Independently summed all nine factorial terms symbolically and verified equality. Every t with Im(t)<0 occurs as reciprocal of z-conj(w). The quadratic in t² has discriminant 36[(a²-b)²-(10/3)b²]; nonnegative case is equivalent to a²>=b+sqrt(10/3)|b| because the opposite branch is impossible for a²>=0. Real positive t² roots are excluded; nonreal conjugate t² yield exactly two simple attainable lower-half-plane roots. Handles b=0, a=b=0 and equality real double roots; does not count fixed-w-slice zeros.
